protocol: Accuracy only. Original real Spectra matrices/v0; LM, tol=1e-10, maxiter=budget for each backend. Original ncv and explicitly widened ncv=min(n, max(2*original_ncv, 4*k)) are separate profiles. Very-wide uses 4*original_ncv instead of 2*original_ncv. Complex ARPACK casts identical real inputs to exercise complex Arnoldi. Every returned set is checked against an independent dense spectrum, including mandatory modes above conjugate cutoff ties.
